mapper.select: SELECT e.employee_name AS employeeName, e.employ_state AS employeeState, o.org_name AS orgName, j.job_name AS jobName, p.position_name AS positionName, e.email AS email, e.phone AS phone, e.ext AS extensionNum, w.area_name AS areaName, f.file_url AS profileFileUrl FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info hr ON hr.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON hr.org_id = o.org_id LEFT JOIN `position` p ON hr.position_id = p.position_id LEFT JOIN job j ON hr.job_id = j.job_id LEFT JOIN working_area w ON hr.area_id = w.area_id LEFT JOIN hr_file f ON f.hr_file_id = e.profile_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId} LIMIT 1

SELECT e.employee_num AS employeeNum, e.employee_name AS employeeName, e.email AS email, e.phone AS phone, e.ext AS extensionNum, e.birth_date AS birthDate, e.address AS address, e.resident_number_enc AS residentNumberEnc, e.bank_name AS bankName, e.account_number_enc AS accountNumberEnc, f.file_url AS profileFileUrl FROM employee e LEFT JOIN hr_file f ON f.hr_file_id = e.profile_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT o.org_name AS orgName, p.position_name AS positionName, r.rank_name AS rankName, j.job_name AS jobName, e.employ_state AS employeeState, e.hire_date AS hireDate, hr.employ_type AS employType, hr.recruit_type AS recruitType, w.area_name AS areaName FROM employee_hr_info hr JOIN employee e ON hr.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON hr.org_id = o.org_id LEFT JOIN `position` p ON hr.position_id = p.position_id LEFT JOIN `rank` r ON hr.rank_id = r.rank_id LEFT JOIN job j ON hr.job_id = j.job_id LEFT JOIN working_area w ON hr.area_id = w.area_id WHERE hr.employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT s.skill_id AS skillId, s.category AS category, s.skill_name AS skillName, DATE_FORMAT(s.acquisition_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS acquisitionDate, s.license_number AS licenseNumber, s.hr_file_id AS hrFileId FROM employee_skill_credential s WHERE s.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY s.acquisition_date DESC, s.skill_id DESC

SELECT c.career_id AS careerId, c.company_name AS companyName, c.org_name AS orgName, DATE_FORMAT(c.start_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(c.end_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS endDate, c.hr_file_id AS hrFileId FROM employee_career_details c WHERE c.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY c.start_date DESC, c.career_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_skill_credential ( employee_id, category, skill_name, acquisition_date, license_number, hr_file_id ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{category}, #{skillName}, #{acquisitionDate}, #{licenseNumber}, #{hrFileId} )
mapper.select: SELECT f.hr_file_id AS hrFileId, f.file_url AS fileUrl, f.file_title AS fileTitle FROM employee_skill_credential s JOIN hr_file f ON f.hr_file_id = s.hr_file_id WHERE s.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND s.skill_id = #{skillId} LIMIT 1

SELECT f.hr_file_id AS hrFileId, f.file_url AS fileUrl, f.file_title AS fileTitle FROM employee_career_details c JOIN hr_file f ON f.hr_file_id = c.hr_file_id WHERE c.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND c.career_id = #{careerId} LIMIT 1

SELECT ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee e WHERE e.profile_id = #{hrFileId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee_skill_credential s WHERE s.hr_file_id = #{hrFileId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee_career_details c WHERE c.hr_file_id = #{hrFileId}) ) AS refCount
